title: ECHO: Early-layer Collaborative Hierarchical Orchestration with Bonus Logits in Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2609.17241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While draft-model-free speculative decoding offers a promising path to efficient LLM inference, it is frequently constrained by stale draft candidates and the high computational cost of the verification. To address these challenges, we propose ECHO, a hierarchical dual-loop framework that exploits the functional asymmetry between LLM layers. Leveraging the high discriminative efficiency of early layers and the authoritative distribution of final layers, ECHO bifurcates inference into a high-frequency inner loop and a low-frequency outer loop. Within the inner loop, early-layer bonus logits drive rapid, multi-step draft-tree exploration at a minimal cost. Simultaneously, the outer loop performs authoritative full-model verification through a state-reuse mechanism. Crucially, the outer loop also utilizes final-layer bonus logits to correct existing paths and supplement the tree with high-confidence candidates for subsequent cycles. Experim

translated_title: ECHO：投机解码中基于奖励Logits的早层协同分层编排
translated_abstract: 虽然无需草稿模型的投机解码为高效大语言模型（LLM）推理提供了一条有前景的路径，但它常常受到草稿候选过时以及验证计算成本高昂的制约。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了ECHO，一种利用LLM各层之间功能不对称性的分层双循环框架。借助早层的高判别效率和末层的权威分布，ECHO将推理划分为高频内循环和低频外循环。在内循环中，早层奖励logits以极低的成本驱动快速的多步草稿树探索。与此同时，外循环通过状态复用机制执行权威的全模型验证。至关重要的是，外循环还利用末层奖励logits修正现有路径，并为后续循环补充高置信度候选节点以丰富草稿树。
tldr: ECHO提出了一种利用LLM早层与末层功能不对称性的分层双循环投机解码框架，通过早层奖励logits低成本快速探索草稿树、末层奖励logits修正路径并补充高置信度候选，实现了高效且验证成本低的无草稿模型LLM推理。
en_tdlr: ECHO proposes a hierarchical dual-loop speculative decoding framework exploiting the functional asymmetry between LLM layers, where early-layer bonus logits enable rapid low-cost draft-tree exploration while final-layer bonus logits correct paths and supplement high-confidence candidates, achieving efficient draft-model-free LLM inference with reduced verification costs.
